messages:
Anna: Hey team — VertexCompute called, they want a joint perf/W + kernel-tuning sweep for our Responder-13B workload. Goal is a short public blog + a joint benchmark page. Can we sketch a plan this week? :spiral_calendar:

Mike: 👍 I can own kernel tuning. Need to know which metrics we commit to (power vs throughput tradeoffs). Also require SSH access to the test nodes and their power telemetry (IPMI or DCIM).

Sarah: Suggested metrics: throughput (tokens/s), perf/W (tokens/s per watt), p50/p95/p99 latency, memory footprint, and quantization-induced quality delta (ROUGE/BLEU-ish for gen). Also include sample distribution: seq len 64/512, batch sizes 1/8/32.

Josh: For repeatability let's use our harness (run-bench.sh) and pin seeds. Example run command we use internally:

```
./run-bench.sh --model responder-13b --quant q4_0 --seq-len 512 --batch 8 --iters 100 --power-monitor ipmi --save results/vertex/round1
```

Make sure power monitor is on the same NTP time.

Mike: Good. On Vertex side we can do BIOS knobs + cuDNN kernel selector changes. I'm thinking of sweeping: power cap {200W, 250W, 300W}, sm clocks {default, +5%}, and cudnn conv heuristic overrides. Will log GPU clocks and temps.

Anna: Claire — we need to confirm what language is allowed in the joint blog and whether Vertex requires signoff on numbers. Any NDA or co-marketing constraints?

Claire: Quick check: Vertex's PR team already asked for a numbers embargo until both parties sign off. Also need a joint quote approval process. We can proceed with internal numbers but no external publishing until legal says go.

Mike: OK. For the internal canary run, can Vertex provide 3 x A100-like nodes with power telemetry? If yes I can start a 48-hour sweep. Requesting a test window Tue 00:00-06:00 UTC to avoid noisy infra.

Anna: I'll ask Vertex to confirm Tuesday low-noise window. If they can't do Tue, Wed AM is backup. Also want a doc for the blog draft and a short one-pager on methods.

Josh: I'll spin up the bench infra and add a CI job that collects perf counters + power. Also will upload a reproducibility artifact to S3: s3://redwood-partners/vertex/vertex-responder13b. Will include run script and raw logs.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: bench-infra/vertex-test cluster will be provisioned at 2025-11-17T23:45Z. Image: rwd/bench:20251117.

Sarah: For quality checks, let's reserve ~500 eval prompts from our public eval suite + 100 hand-curated prompts for hallucination checks. We'll report delta vs baseline float16.

Mike: Noted. One more ask: can Vertex expose wall-power (watt-hour) or do they only provide GPU power draw? Ideally we want system-level perf/W. If not available we'll estimate via PSU readings and note in methods.

Anna: Great thread — action items: (1) Anna to confirm Tue window with Vertex; (2) Mike to draft tuning matrix and config; (3) Josh to provision bench infra and CI job; (4) Sarah to pick eval subset; (5) Claire to draft quote/approval flow. Ping me when you have drafts.

Mike: I'll upload the tuning matrix by EOD Monday to the shared doc (link to follow).

Josh: CI job PR incoming in ~3h.

Claire: I'll send a draft approval checklist to the thread.

Anna: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10:30 PT if needed. :thumbsup:
